name: interpretive-interface
description: Modern Android 15 voice-first communicative interface with real-time STT/TTS, hands-free SMS audio reading, and background audio bridge.

tech_stack.framework: Android Jetpack Compose, Material3, Foreground Services

features: VoiceBridgeService foreground daemon with persistent audio notification
Hands-free SMS reading via SmsReceiver and TextToSpeechManager
Push-to-talk audio input gate and Bluetooth headset trigger hooks
Modern Jetpack Compose conversational chat screen
